en.dark mode_tooltip: Colony backgrounds will match with the mode: nighttime for dark mode and daytime for light mode.
en.fullscreen scaling_tooltip: If enabled, fullscreen will display as large as possible (toggle fullscreen to update). This may include visual artifacts.
en.no sprite antialiasing_tooltip: If enabled, sprites and patrol art will no longer be antialiased ("blurry"/"smooth") when in fullscreen.
en.custom cursor_tooltip: The cursor will be replaced with a cat paw. The cursor is currently unfinished and is prone to crashing.
en.keybinds_tooltip: Enables certain keybinds to be used throughout the menus for quick navigation.
en.shaders_tooltip: This will add a shading layer onto the ant sprites.
en.gore: Allow mild gore and blood in patrol artwork
en.gore_tooltip: Mild gore and blood will be allowed in the artwork displayed alongside patrols.
en.discord_tooltip: Discord will show info about your Colony, including your Colony name
en.check_for_updates_tooltip: Automatically checks for updates on startup
en.show_changelog_tooltip: Shows the changelog of the latest release on startup
en.special_dates_tooltip: Certain changes may be made to the game on special days such as April Fools
en.random relation: Randomize relationship values when creating Colonies
en.random relation_tooltip: Colony founder ants will start the game with established relationships.
en.they them default_tooltip: If this setting is on, new ants will generate with they/them pronouns regardless of gender.
en.disasters_tooltip: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Colony dying in one moon.
en.showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
en.showxp_tooltip: Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
en.random med cat: Allow clerics to be randomly selected on patrol
en.random med cat_tooltip: Clerics can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
en.fading: Allow dead ants to fade away
en.fading_tooltip: After 202 moons, dead ants will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
en.save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded ant information
en.save_faded_copy_tooltip: A complete copy of faded ant save info will be saved in plain-text.
en.backgrounds_tooltip: Even with this off, the Colony background you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
en.moons and seasons_tooltip: Displays Colony age and current Colony season on several pages.
en.deputy: Allow monarchs to automatically choose a new heir
en.deputy_tooltip: The Worker Code rules will be taken into account when choosing a heir.
en.12_moon_graduation_tooltip: All apprentices will graduate at 12 moons.
en.retirement: Ants will never retire due to a permanent condition
en.retirement_tooltip: When this setting is off, ants with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire
en.become_mediator: Allow workers and elders to choose to become diplomats
en.become_mediator_tooltip: Workers and elders will have a chance to become diplomats upon moonskip.
en.affair: Allow ants to breed with ants that aren't their mates
en.affair_tooltip: This will allow mated and unmated ants to have eggs with other ants they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
en.same sex birth_tooltip: Allow all ants to become egg-bound despite their gender and all couples to lay eggs despite same-sex status.
en.same sex adoption_tooltip: If same-sex egg-bounding is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
en.single parentage: Allow ants to have eggs with an unknown second parent
en.single parentage_tooltip: Allow ants to have eggs with an unknown second biological parent. The ant will be listed as the only biological parent.
en.romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
en.romantic with former mentor_tooltip: Allows mentors and the ants they trained to be romantic after they become workers.
en.first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
en.first cousin mates_tooltip: Allows ants with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.
en.by-status_tooltip: The Colony will be fed according to their status. Priority is determined by age within statuses.
en.younger first_tooltip: The youngest members of the Colony are fed first
en.less nutrition first_tooltip: The hungriest ants are fed first, then the rest are fed according to their status.
en.hunter first_tooltip: Proficient foragers are fed first, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.sick/injured first_tooltip: Any injured or sick ants are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.more experience first_tooltip: The most experienced members of the Colony are fed first.
en.ration prey_tooltip: Healthy workers will only eat half the food they need, even if there is enough for the Colony.
en.business as usual_tooltip: The Colony has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
en.hunting_tooltip: The Colony will focus on foraging: each working worker (including heirs and monarchs) and each working apprentice will gather additional food on each moonskip.
en.herb gathering_tooltip: The Colony will focus on herb gathering: each cleric and cleric apprentice will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the workers.
en.threaten outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with ants outside of the Colony decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from the workers.
en.seek outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with ants outside of the Colony increases as the workers make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
en.rest and recover_tooltip: The Colony will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
en.sabotage other clans_tooltip: Your diplomats and workers collaborate to undermine the other Colonies. Only available if you have a working diplomat. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Colonies you target.
en.aid other clans_tooltip: Your diplomats and workers collaborate to help the other Colonies with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working diplomat. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Colonies you target.
en.raid other clans_tooltip: Your workers begin crossing borders for resources. Food and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Colonies decrease. You will be able to choose which Colonies you target.
en.hoarding_tooltip: Your workers begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their tarsi on, regardless of their own safety. Food and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
